remarks: Great opportunity to live in a beautiful and completely renovated 2 Bedroom, 1 Bath top floor apartment, surrounded by well maintained landscape grounds with mature trees and terrace. Sun filters through brand new windows and reduces utility bill. New carpet and fresh paint throughout. 2 well appointed bedrooms with new ceiling light/fan fixtures. Large eat-n kitchen, completely renovated, equipped with all new appliances and ambiance lighting under the kitchen cabinets. The bathroom also remodeled with new vanity, shower walls, fixtures and porcelain tiled floor. Onsite assigned tenant parking and guests parking. Additionally, the apartment includes a large storage room and onsite coin-operated laundry facility. Conveniently located near Norwalk Hospital, Highways, train station, just minutes away from The SoNo Collection Mall and vibrant Norwalk Downtown. This apartment offers modern style, convenience and comfort. See Requirements and Schedual private showing and experience all this unit has to offer.
